patches.title: Preserve ptrdiff_t row strides in simplified PNG writes
patches.description: Backports upstream commit cf155de to avoid truncating large or negative row strides in the simplified write API.

dep3.origin: Backport of the upstream simplified-write row-stride fix.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed Ubuntu Focal libpng16-16 1.6.37-2 package reproduces an invalid read through png_image_write_to_file/libpng16.so.16 for the negative row-stride fixture under Memcheck (error exit status 97).
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed candidate package completes the same negative-stride write with no Memcheck errors and exit status 0.
